description: What changed on the public Monity Network, newest first: on a whole site ("what changed on nike.com this week") or on one tracker, optionally only since a date. Each change has its title, before/after values, an AI summary when there is one, who it came from (Monity detected it, with evidence; the tracker's owner posted it; or an external source posted it), and a url to cite. Give exactly one of domain, watchlist (a tracker with several sources) or watch (a tracker with one source).

domain.description: A site, e.g. nike.com or https://www.nike.com/…

since.description: Only changes from this ISO 8601 date or time on, e.g. 2026-09-01

watch.description: A one-source tracker's slug or id

watchlist.description: A tracker's slug or id, for a tracker with several sources

name: get_network_changes
title: Get Network changes
